Comments (English): [ Dishwasher is fine - HATE the app! ] || ---------------- || My old Bosch lasted 15+ years. Loved it. This dishwasher seems fine and I have high hopes it will go a long time. There's some things you can't control, such as, water swirling and emptying into the garbage disposal. I did notice while wiping the front clean that the door did push in and my last one never did that. I think my old one was made thicker on the door and that helped better with noise. If you're not in the kitchen or a living room right by it, you will not hear it running. Overall, I got it on sale and am happy with the dishwasher and hope to get a decade out of it.

Sentence (English): I have had my new Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher for a month now.
Comments (English): I have had my new Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher for a month now. The delivery of my new dishwasher was within the time frame specified and the team did a great job of unloading it and removing all packing material with now damage to the dishwasher. I chose to install it myself do to some plumbing and electrical changes needing to be done first. The installation instructions were very clear and accurate and all parts listed were included. Installation went smoothly. The Dishwasher has been working well though I am still getting used to the best way and time to wash so that the dishes get dry. The machine is incredibly quiet. I find that at times I wouldn't know it is running if not for the red LED light shining on the floor at the front of the machine, this even when standing near it. The quiet running is definitely it's strongest point in my opinion. All dishes come out clean even on the shortest cycle, it's just the drying that I am unsure of at this time but I have found that running it at night the dishes are dry by morning. All said, I would recommend this dishwasher especially if quiet running is important.

Sentence (English): It seems the hottest item for kitchen helpers these days is the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ #SeriouslyFoundMyHope #WhyDidIDoThisNow #ItsSoConvenient ] || ---------------- || It seems the hottest item for kitchen helpers these days is the dishwasher. I often saw reviews saying that dishwashers don't clean very well, so I was considering just hand-washing and buying a dryer instead. However, with the sudden arrival of my second child, I decided to use a separate bottle sterilizer and wanted to free myself from dishwashing, even if just a little. Coincidentally, the Samsung Appreciation Festival was underway, so I made the big decision to buy a Samsung Electronics 6-place setting dishwasher. Honestly, if I owned my own home, I would have gone for the 14-place setting model because bigger is better, but since I move frequently, I purchased a countertop model. Even with just a family of three, we still have quite a bit of dishes to wash for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, so I lived without realizing how convenient this was. It is such a great purchase that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. Usually, there are about 10 dishes in the morning, so I pre-wash them and run the quick cycle. In the evening, I wash the dishes from lunch and dinner at once, using Standard, High Heat, Extra Rinse, and Dry depending on the situation that day. For a family of 3 to 4, the storage space is sufficient if you run it as needed. It is great that you can easily wash small sizes of large pots and pans. Even greasy food containers came out squeaky clean after I gave them a quick wipe before running the cycle. For cups used for milk in the morning, running them on a high setting—different from the quick cycle—prevents milk odors and water stains, making it much more hygienic to manage and a product that significantly improves my quality of life. Since the countertop model is visible and quite large, it can make the kitchen look a bit cramped. Also, you need to stack dishes properly according to the direction of the water stream for effective cleaning, so it takes some getting used to. Aside from these points, I am generally satisfied, so please don't keep putting it off like I did until you finally see the light. I hope you buy a dishwasher as soon as possible and find some peace of mind.

Sentence (English): I purchased a Bosch dishwasher because of its reputation for quality, reliability, and longevity.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 Series Dishwasher 2026 ] || ---------------- || I purchased a Bosch dishwasher because of its reputation for quality, reliability, and longevity. As someone who doesn't typically spend this kind of money on appliances, I viewed it as a long-term investment and expected exceptional performance. Unfortunately, my experience has been disappointing. First, the drying performance has not lived up to expectations. The interior of the dishwasher often remains damp after a cycle, and there is a lingering odor inside the machine I did not expect from a brand-new appliance. The detergent dispenser is another frustration. Closing the dispenser requires a surprising amount of precision. Instead of simply clicking shut, I often have to try two or three times before the small latch finally engages. It may seem like a minor issue, but when you're using the dishwasher daily, those little annoyances add up. I was also under the impression modern premium dishwashers could handle dishes that were scraped but not pre-rinsed. In my experience, dishes that go in with normal food residue frequently come out needing additional cleaning. That was one of the features I was most looking forward to, and it has not met my expectations. I also experienced a white film on my dishes. I eventually resolved the issue by placing a bowl of vinegar in the dishwasher during a cycle, but I don't believe a premium dishwasher should require household chemistry experiments to produce sparkling clean dishes. To be fair, the dishwasher is quiet, attractive, and well-designed in many respects. However, for a product positioned as a premium appliance, I expected a more user-friendly experience and better cleaning and drying performance right out of the box. Maybe my expectations were too high, but when you purchase a Bosch, you're not buying a dishwasher—you're buying the dream you've finally reached the dishwasher promised land. So far, I've arrived, but I'm still looking for the promised land part.

The detergent dispenser is another frustration. Closing the dispenser requires a surprising amount of precision. I eventually resolved the issue by placing a bowl of vinegar in the dishwasher during a cycle, but I don't believe a premium dishwasher should require household chemistry experiments to produce sparkling clean dishes. To be fair, the dishwasher is quiet, attractive, and well-designed in many respects. However, for a product positioned as a premium appliance, I expected a more user-friendly experience and better cleaning and drying performance right out of the box. Maybe my expectations were too high, but when you purchase a Bosch, you're not buying a dishwasher—you're buying the dream you've finally reached the dishwasher promised land. So far, I've arrived, but I'm still looking for the promised land part.

Sentence (English): We have installed multiple dishwashers over the years, and unfortunately this was by far the most difficult installation.
Comments (English): [ Quiet & Effective but Frustrating Installation ] || ---------------- || We have installed multiple dishwashers over the years, and unfortunately this was by far the most difficult installation. What should have been a straightforward project turned into many hours of work and multiple trips to Lowe's. We had just purchased our home and didn't realize until the old dishwasher was disconnected that the included drain hose was too short because it had to route around a lazy Susan corner cabinet. The instructions mention that an extension hose may be needed, but they do not explain how to install one. We also had to purchase a special fitting to prevent the water supply line from making a sharp 90-degree bend and kinking.The leveling instructions were confusing, relying on water in the bottom of the dishwasher rather than a standard level. The mounting brackets also required modification to fit our cabinets.That said, the dishwasher is exceptionally quiet and cleans dishes very well. However, the bottom rack does not roll smoothly, the third rack is only useful for flatware, and dishes do not fully dry unless the extended dry feature is used. Overall, the performance is good, but the design and installation experience were disappointing.

Sentence (English): This is our second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is our second Bosch dishwasher. We had such great success with the first one in our old house that we decided to get one for our new house. We have not been disappointed. The dishwasher runs so quietly we have to keep a sign on it to know it is on. The dishes are very clean and we have so much room. What I also like with this model is that the controls are on the door rather than on the inside. So much easier to do things with it. Finally, we like that it is able to be controlled from the app. That way if we forget to start it we can do so even though we aren't home. We have recommended this dishwasher to many of our friends already.

Sentence (English): I had previously owned a 800 Series dishwasher and was extremely satisfied with it.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I had previously owned a 800 Series dishwasher and was extremely satisfied with it. The 500 Series, not so much. The unit feels "cheap" compared to my previous unit. The top silverware tray is not as smooth when being extended. The delay start function is now controlled via an app that needs to be reset more oftwn than expected. I preferred selecting the delay function via the control panel. Once you set the delay start you can't open the door to put another item in without having to restart the delay via tha app. If you don't remember you'll have dirty dishes in the morning. I will say the unit does run quietly. The assisted drying feature is nice as well. If I had to do it again I might bump up to the 800 Series again however I'm not sure if that would make a difference. On a personal note I prefer an outside grab bar vs what you see in the picture. It's an upgrade and not readily available at the big box store I shopped at.

Sentence (English): Overall I am happy with this purchase.
Comments (English): [ Our new Bosch 800 ] || ---------------- || Overall I am happy with this purchase. The unit very quiet and looks really good. Also, it cleans and dries well. I knew going in that there would be a learning curve on how to load this dishwasher. I am getting used to the upper utensil rack—and I like it. I love the configuration of the bottom rack. It was actually why we selected the Bosch over other brands and I am really happy with it. But I do have a few issues: The center rack does not hold as much as my previous DW and the configuration is weird. On the left side, the space for loading glasses is smaller than the on the right side, so many of our cups, mugs and glasses do not fit. Also, there is no logical way to load bowls in the middle rack—you just have to lay them down in the center area. There are no tongs to hold them up and separate them. The biggest issue though is that, because the dishwasher is so well sealed, it STINKS. I asked a friend who also has a Bosch (in case it was just ours) and hers stinks too. So I devised a contraption to keep the unit upen slightly when not in use and that has solved the problem. But now the unit does not look as sleek because you can see the control panel. I guess it is the lesser of 2 evils. Overall—because I like the quiet and I love the bottom rack, I am glad we made the purchase. I do think the smell issue should be addressed.

Sentence (English): I didn't purchase this dishwasher (GDF510PGR3BB) from Home Depot but I'm searching here for a new one because it died.
Comments (English): [ Lasted 3 Decent Years ] || ---------------- || I didn't purchase this dishwasher (GDF510PGR3BB) from Home Depot but I'm searching here for a new one because it died. I'd probably give this dishwasher a 2.5 honestly but I'm being gracious because I didn't pay separately for it. It was added to our new house less than 4 years ago. A few months ago it it would come on but not finish random loads, then it stopped altogether. I did all the troubleshooting and think it's the control panel. Off and on during its lifetime the detergent lid wouldn't open to release so we'd have to rerun. None of the dry settings worked great, something would always be wet. Sentence (English): Overall I am happy with this purchase.
Comments (English): [ Our new Bosch 800 ] || ---------------- || Overall I am happy with this purchase. The unit very quiet and looks really good. Also, it cleans and dries well. I knew going in that there would be a learning curve on how to load this dishwasher. I am getting used to the upper utensil rack—and I like it. I love the configuration of the bottom rack. It was actually why we selected the Bosch over other brands and I am really happy with it. But I do have a few issues:. The center rack does not hold as much as my previous DW and the configuration is weird. On the left side, the space for loading glasses is smaller than the on the right side, so many of our cups, mugs and glasses do not fit. Also, there is no logical way to load bowls in the middle rack—you just have to lay them down in the center area. There are no tongs to hold them up and separate them. The biggest issue though is that, because the dishwasher is so well sealed, it STINKS. I asked a friend who also has a Bosch (in case it was just ours) and hers stinks too. So I devised a contraption to keep the unit upen slightly when not in use and that has solved the problem. But now the unit does not look as sleek because you can see the control panel. I guess it is the lesser of 2 evils. Overall—because I like the quiet and I love the bottom rack, I am glad we made the purchase. I do think the smell issue should be addressed.

Sentence (English): Let's be honest: I didn't buy a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I used to hate doing dishes. Now, I'm all in! ] || ---------------- || Let's be honest: I didn't buy a dishwasher. I bought a mechanical miracle worker that saved my life and cured my post-dinner depression. The Bosch SHX78CM5N is an absolute beast masquerading as a sleek kitchen appliance.Here is why this machine is the MVP of my entire house:It is dangerously quiet: Seriously. The first week we had it, I kept walking into the kitchen and pressing my ear against the door like a safecracker just to see if it was actually running. It's so quiet (42 dBA! ) that Bosch had to build a literal laser beam—the InfoLight—that shines a red dot on the floor just so you don't accidentally open it mid-cycle and give yourself an unprompted facial steam.The "CrystalDry" black magic: I don't know what kind of sci-fi witchcraft Bosch engineered into this thing, but it turns moisture into pure heat. Plastics? Bone dry. Tupperware containers that usually hold a swimming pool of water on top? Dry. It feels like playing a highly rewarding game of kitchen Tetris where you always win.It actually washes the dishes: Crazy concept, right? I deliberately left a casserole dish coated in baked-on, crusty cheese on the counter for 24 hours as a test. I didn't pre-rinse it. I just shoved it in and prayed. It came out looking cleaner than the day I bought it.If you are on the fence about spending the money on a Bosch 800 Series, just do it. Your sanity, your plastics, and your ears will thank you.

Sentence (English): Purchased based on reviews and solid recommendations regarding Bosch dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Disappointed: Drying, loading config & speed ] || ---------------- || Purchased based on reviews and solid recommendations regarding Bosch dishwashers. Problem 1: "Crystal Dry" is not effective. No matter how the dishes are loaded, a significant amount of them are always wet, even an hour after the wash finishes. Problem 2: The loading and racking configuration is poor. It lacks much-needed spline configuration and flexibility. The end result is an inefficient load configuration that requires me to run 2 cycles to get all dishes washed. Problem 3: The washer is quiet, but it is SLOW. It takes too long to run even the 60-minute cycle (which is longer than 60 minutes). Other cycles take ~3 hours to complete. Problem 4: No rinse-only cycle. There are times when I don't want to run a full cycle, but rather want to run a quick rinse and dry. The washer is "on rails" - lacks the flexibility and performance to remain in my house. I'm returning it.

Comments (English): [ Not as full featured v. cheaper competitors ] || ---------------- || The 800 series dishwasher delivers on its promise of being quiet (nearly silent). However, it lacks some "convenience" features lower priced competitors have that I actually miss. For example, other than short tone, there's no indicator that the dishwasher is done (my previous model had a dim LED light that shined on the floor (blue for running, green for done). To see if it's done, you have to use the app (or be around to hear the tone). There's also not a temperature setting for the drying cycle. Heat is always used--the previous dishwasher I had allowed you to set a lower temp (so your plastics don't melt on the bottom rack). Otherwise, the unit functions as advertised, but not sure I'd get this brand again in the future.

Especially since it's a product from a small to medium-sized company, let's add that 6,000 won and use it with peace of mind.

Comments (English): [ Clean white design! She's the best auntie. ] || ---------------- || [Motivation for Purchase and Reason for Selection]. As a dual-income household, the pile of dishes left to wash after dinner was always a source of stress. It happened to be during the Samsung Home Appliance Rebate Festival, so it was an opportunity to purchase with great benefits. Additionally, having heard advice from seniors that a dishwasher would be essential for future childcare—such as sterilizing bottles and washing baby dishes—I decided to purchase one in advance for the future. [Design and Kitchen Interior Harmony]. I chose 'White' for the color, which makes the kitchen look brightest and most spacious, and it was an excellent choice. Thanks to the clean and luxurious matte white tone characteristic of Bespoke, it blends naturally into the interior as if it were originally part of the set, without feeling cramped even when placed on the kitchen counter. Another major advantage is that, being a countertop model, it can be installed neatly with a visit, without the need for extensive renovations to the lower cabinets. [Capacity and Storage Convenience]. With a capacity for 6 people, it is more than sufficient to handle the dishes used throughout the day or the pile of dishes that accumulates over the weekend all at once for a two-person household. The internal basket is well-designed to fit Korean tableware, securely holding rice and soup bowls deep inside, allowing for efficient storage of even frying pans and pots. I feel confident that I will be able to use it without worrying about a lack of space even if baby tableware is added later. [Review on Cleaning Power and Functionality]. At first, I was skeptical whether it would be as clean as hand washing, but thanks to the high-temperature direct water spray, even greasy frying pans and dishes with burnt-on sauce are cleaned perfectly until they squeak. In particular, the high-temperature sterilization washing function provides much greater peace of mind regarding hygiene compared to hand washing, and I think it will be very useful for maintaining the hygiene of baby products in the future. After washing is finished, the door opens automatically to release internal steam, so the items dry fluffily without any musty water smell. [Overall Review and Recommendation]. Thanks to the appliance rebate benefit, it has dramatically improved my quality of life at a reasonable price! Comments (English): After contemplating what to give my parents as a thoughtful gift, I decided to purchase the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher. I was also always worried about my father; even though I tried to help with the housework, dishwashing requires more time and physical strength than I had anticipated. Comments (English): After contemplating what to give my parents as a thoughtful gift, I decided to purchase the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher. If you are looking for a gift for your parents, newlyweds, or dual-income families, I would highly recommend the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher. Sentence (English): The biggest change since installation.
Comments (English): The biggest change since installation. The most significant change is the extra time I have in the evenings. For a family of four, we use it once a day after dinner, saving the 20 to 30 minutes we used to spend on dishwashing. Since all we have to do is put the dishes in immediately after a meal and press a button, we can spend time with our family or relax. It is especially effective when guests come over. In the past, I used to get stressed looking at the pile of dishes in the sink after meals, but now that I can just put them in the dishwasher, the burden has been greatly reduced. Washing performance. It cleans much more thoroughly than expected. Greasy frying pans, stains on soup bowls, and discoloration on coffee cups are mostly removed cleanly. However, if rice grains are completely dried and stuck on, it is much better to soak them in water or pre-rinse them. Glass cups often came out even shinier than when washed by hand. Electricity and water costs. Since it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency product, the cost is low. Based on the product sticker: Electricity usage per cycle: 603Wh. Water usage: 1.3L per person. Estimated energy cost: Approximately 35,000 won per year. After actually using it, it feels like it uses less water than leaving the water running continuously when washing dishes by hand. Noise. I was worried about the noise at first, but it is quieter than expected. Even in a layout where the living room and kitchen are connected, it is quiet enough not to significantly interfere with watching TV or conversation. I often run it before going to bed. Recommended for: Dual-income couples; families of 3 to 4 or more; people who cook frequently; those who want to reduce dishwashing stress; and those who want to save time on housework. "If you are debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher, I recommend it if you have the space. My only regret is thinking, 'I should have bought it sooner.'"

In the past, I used to get stressed looking at the pile of dishes in the sink after meals, but now that I can just put them in the dishwasher, the burden has been greatly reduced. Sentence (English): This GE Profile has less space compared to my previous unit.
Comments (English): [ Not as good as my previous GE Profile ] || ---------------- || This GE Profile has less space compared to my previous unit. Top rack sections don't hold small dishes without them falling over. The lines are too close together. Wine glass will not fit on top rack without hitting the top, even with the upper tray removed. It will not accommodate coffee mugs that are wide. Top rack upper tray - can't put long knives in the rack as they also hit the top of the unit. Everything was made smaller, space wise, and my usual items don't fit anymore. Very dissatisfied, as my previous GE Profile was excellent. My previous unit I was able to run it in less than an hour. This new unit takes 2hours and 55mins. to complete the shortest cycle. Way too long. A waste of energy, that I'm paying for. I also don't like using recycled water! Not fond of the new wifi technology. Less is better. For older people that is very confusing. Just one more thing to go wrong. My bottom rack that holds the silverware is very narrow and smaller than previous unit. It tilts outward to the right and hits the rubber on the side of the unit every time I push the rack in or pull it out. Eventually it will rip the rubber edging. We pay more and get less. May rethink a different brand next time.

Sentence (English): I bought this premium Bosch dishwasher expecting a luxury, hassle-free experience.
Comments (English): [ Great machine on paper, total nightmare to use ] || ---------------- || I bought this premium Bosch dishwasher expecting a luxury, hassle-free experience. While I cannot fault how well it cleans or how quiet it is, the user interface and button panel are so incredibly frustrating and unintuitive that I completely regret this purchase.If you are thinking about buying this machine, you need to know about these major daily annoyances:The Ridiculous Start Sequence: You cannot simply close the dishwasher and hit start. You have to open the door, turn it on, select your settings, hit start while the door is wide open, and then slam it shut within 3 to 5 seconds. If you miss that tiny window, the machine times out, flashes, and refuses to run.Unresponsive Touch Panel: The capacitive touch buttons are incredibly finicky. Half the time they don't register a normal finger press. If your hands are even slightly damp or oily from cooking, the panel completely ignores you.Over-Engineered Locks: If you open the door mid-cycle to throw in a forgotten mug, the machine freezes. It doesn't automatically resume when closed; it forces you to hit the start button again, or it will just sit there doing nothing all night.No Heating Element: Be warned that this machine uses "condensation drying." If you use a lot of plastic containers or don't want to constantly buy liquid rinse aid, your dishes will stay soaking wet.Appliances are supposed to make your life easier. This machine adds daily frustration to a simple household chore. Do yourself a favor: go to a physical showroom and test the buttons before you buy this. I wish I had.

Sentence (English): While contemplating what to give my parents as a gift to show my filial piety, I decided to purchase the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher.
Comments (English): While contemplating what to give my parents as a gift to show my filial piety, I decided to purchase the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher. My mother usually spent a lot of time doing the dishes herself after meals, and I often saw her straining her wrists and lower back, especially on weekends or holidays when the whole family gathers and the volume of dishes is heavy. I was also always worried about my father; even though I tried to help with the housework, dishwashing requires more time and physical strength than I had anticipated. Therefore, I decided to gift a dishwasher to lighten their household burden, even just a little. After comparing various products, I chose the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher because of its cleaning power, hygiene management features, and luxurious design. I liked that it cleans even greasy dishes and pots thoroughly, and its excellent drying performance means there is almost no need to wipe them dry. Furthermore, thanks to its sophisticated design that blends well with the kitchen interior, the atmosphere of my parents' kitchen has become even cleaner and more upscale. As expected, my mother was the most satisfied after the installation. At first, she didn't feel a great need for it, saying, "I can do the dishes myself," but after using it for a few days, her opinion completely changed. They said it is incredibly convenient because all they have to do after a meal is put the dishes in and press a button, and it automatically finishes washing and drying. They particularly appreciated that their hands no longer get cold or become rough from prolonged use of detergent. They mentioned that these days, they can spend more leisure time talking with their family or watching TV after meals without worrying about washing dishes. My father was also highly satisfied. He said that it used to take time to help with the dishes, but now it is much more convenient since he only has to organize and put them away. Above all, both parents cited the reduced time spent on housework as the biggest advantage, which has given them more free time in their daily lives. Watching them use it firsthand made me feel proud, as it felt like I had given them the gift of time rather than just a home appliance. If you are looking for a gift for your parents, newlyweds, or dual-income families, I would highly recommend the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher. I believe it is a highly satisfying product that reduces the burden of dishwashing, provides hygienic maintenance and excellent convenience, and even improves the quality of life for the family.

Sentence (English): After comparing various products, I chose the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher because of its cleaning power, hygiene management features, and luxurious design.
Comments (English): While contemplating what to give my parents as a gift to show my filial piety, I decided to purchase the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher. My mother usually spent a lot of time doing the dishes herself after meals, and I often saw her straining her wrists and lower back, especially on weekends or holidays when the whole family gathers and the volume of dishes is heavy. I was also always worried about my father; even though I tried to help with the housework, dishwashing requires more time and physical strength than I had anticipated. Therefore, I decided to gift a dishwasher to lighten their household burden, even just a little. After comparing various products, I chose the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher because of its cleaning power, hygiene management features, and luxurious design. I liked that it cleans even greasy dishes and pots thoroughly, and its excellent drying performance means there is almost no need to wipe them dry. Furthermore, thanks to its sophisticated design that blends well with the kitchen interior, the atmosphere of my parents' kitchen has become even cleaner and more upscale. As expected, my mother was the most satisfied after the installation. At first, she didn't feel a great need for it, saying, "I can do the dishes myself," but after using it for a few days, her opinion completely changed. They said it is incredibly convenient because all they have to do after a meal is put the dishes in and press a button, and it automatically finishes washing and drying. They particularly appreciated that their hands no longer get cold or become rough from prolonged use of detergent. They mentioned that these days, they can spend more leisure time talking with their family or watching TV after meals without worrying about washing dishes. My father was also highly satisfied. He said that it used to take time to help with the dishes, but now it is much more convenient since he only has to organize and put them away. Above all, both parents cited the reduced time spent on housework as the biggest advantage, which has given them more free time in their daily lives. Watching them use it firsthand made me feel proud, as it felt like I had given them the gift of time rather than just a home appliance. If you are looking for a gift for your parents, newlyweds, or dual-income families, I would highly recommend the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher. I believe it is a highly satisfying product that reduces the burden of dishwashing, provides hygienic maintenance and excellent convenience, and even improves the quality of life for the family.

Comments (English): While contemplating what to give my parents as a gift to show my filial piety, I decided to purchase the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher. Furthermore, thanks to its sophisticated design that blends well with the kitchen interior, the atmosphere of my parents' kitchen has become even cleaner and more upscale. As expected, my mother was the most satisfied after the installation. At first, she didn't feel a great need for it, saying, "I can do the dishes myself," but after using it for a few days, her opinion completely changed. They said it is incredibly convenient because all they have to do after a meal is put the dishes in and press a button, and it automatically finishes washing and drying. They particularly appreciated that their hands no longer get cold or become rough from prolonged use of detergent. Above all, both parents cited the reduced time spent on housework as the biggest advantage, which has given them more free time in their daily lives. Watching them use it firsthand made me feel proud, as it felt like I had given them the gift of time rather than just a home appliance. If you are looking for a gift for your parents, newlyweds, or dual-income families, I would highly recommend the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher. I believe it is a highly satisfying product that reduces the burden of dishwashing, provides hygienic maintenance and excellent convenience, and even improves the quality of life for the family.

Sentence (English): If you are looking for a gift for your parents, newlyweds, or dual-income families, I would highly recommend the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher.
Comments (English): While contemplating what to give my parents as a gift to show my filial piety, I decided to purchase the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher. My mother usually spent a lot of time doing the dishes herself after meals, and I often saw her straining her wrists and lower back, especially on weekends or holidays when the whole family gathers and the volume of dishes is heavy. I was also always worried about my father; even though I tried to help with the housework, dishwashing requires more time and physical strength than I had anticipated. Therefore, I decided to gift a dishwasher to lighten their household burden, even just a little. After comparing various products, I chose the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher because of its cleaning power, hygiene management features, and luxurious design. I liked that it cleans even greasy dishes and pots thoroughly, and its excellent drying performance means there is almost no need to wipe them dry. Furthermore, thanks to its sophisticated design that blends well with the kitchen interior, the atmosphere of my parents' kitchen has become even cleaner and more upscale. As expected, my mother was the most satisfied after the installation. At first, she didn't feel a great need for it, saying, "I can do the dishes myself," but after using it for a few days, her opinion completely changed. They said it is incredibly convenient because all they have to do after a meal is put the dishes in and press a button, and it automatically finishes washing and drying. They particularly appreciated that their hands no longer get cold or become rough from prolonged use of detergent. They mentioned that these days, they can spend more leisure time talking with their family or watching TV after meals without worrying about washing dishes. My father was also highly satisfied. He said that it used to take time to help with the dishes, but now it is much more convenient since he only has to organize and put them away. Above all, both parents cited the reduced time spent on housework as the biggest advantage, which has given them more free time in their daily lives. Watching them use it firsthand made me feel proud, as it felt like I had given them the gift of time rather than just a home appliance. If you are looking for a gift for your parents, newlyweds, or dual-income families, I would highly recommend the LG DIOS Objet Collection Dishwasher. I believe it is a highly satisfying product that reduces the burden of dishwashing, provides hygienic maintenance and excellent convenience, and even improves the quality of life for the family.

Sentence (English): I bought this after hearing reviews from acquaintances who were using it, and I am absolutely satisfied with the product's performance and design!
Comments (English): I bought this after hearing reviews from acquaintances who were using it, and I am absolutely satisfied with the product's performance and design! I am using it very comfortably. I love LG so much that I use LG appliances for every single one of my home appliances, but this time, I was extremely disappointed with the LG brand itself. 1) Delivery issue. Because I was moving, I pre-ordered it a month in advance on April 22nd and scheduled delivery for May 22nd, but it didn't arrive even after two weeks. When I checked the app, the scheduled delivery date just kept increasing day by day, and when I contacted customer service, they said it was still being inspected at the factory. It finally arrived more than two weeks after the scheduled date. 2) Installation company issue. I was told that the installation is handled by a partner company. I considered having an interior design company I know handle it as well, but I decided to entrust it to an official partner company, thinking they would do a more thorough and proper job. The technician came and really worked hard on the installation. (He spent about two hours doing his best.) However, the result is disappointing. The cabinet was cut too short, leaving the back exposed (Photo 1). It is taller than the others and protrudes forward (Photos 2, 3). The adhesive film is torn (Photo 4), the holes inside are left unfinished (Photo 5), and other parts were damaged during installation (Photo 6). Although not shown in the photos, the metal parts inside were cut too long, so the dishwasher installer had a difficult time inserting the unit when he arrived later. After the first installer left, I felt it was completely unacceptable, so I inquired about it, and another technician came to fix it. I was grateful that they did their best to repair the parts where the metal was cut too short and the holes left unfinished. However, since the cabinet is already cut too short and cannot be restored, I am trying to just overlook it and live with it. But the more I use it, the more the refurbished cabinet keeps protruding forward and the heights don't match. It is so incredibly annoying. I open and close it very gently because I'm afraid the door might fall, but it keeps getting more and more misaligned. The intestines have already been completely cut off and cannot be restored, and since it is my new house, I feel upset every time I look at it.

Sentence (English): I remodeled my kitchen sink for the first time in 10 years and replaced the dishwasher at the same time.
Comments (English): I remodeled my kitchen sink for the first time in 10 years and replaced the dishwasher at the same time. With the Samsung 20% promotion added, I ended up with a really good price! I had previously used a Samsung 8-place setting model and was very satisfied with them, but I trusted this one even more knowing that it uses AI to adjust cleaning based on the level of dirt. I liked that I purchased the color and cabinets to match the dishwasher model in advance, creating a sense of unity. Even though it is an older, straight-line kitchen, the 600mm wide dishwasher doesn't feel too big, and I look forward to making dishwashing after dinner much easier for my family of four. The difference between the 14-place and 12-place settings is the presence of an upper cutlery rack. If there is no difference in size, the 14-place setting with the rack is definitely the better choice. Placing a cutlery holder on the bottom shelf is inconvenient in various ways, and interference from the washing blades is also a concern. I ran the unit for the first time after purchasing it, and it is quiet. Thanks to the automatic door opening, I am satisfied using it without needing the hot air drying function. There are more expensive models without handles, but considering the performance and price, it's definitely worth buying! I'll make good use of it while experiencing the various modes!

Sentence (English): It's been faulty since day one.
Comments (English): It's been faulty since day one. They had to replace a part within a week of getting it. And it's been constantly malfunctioning ever since. Always with water. But everything else seems to work fine. Some days it works perfectly, other days not at all. Now the control board has gone completely haywire. It either won't turn off, or it won't turn on. Or it changes programs on its own. The only program that seems to work is Automatic. The rest give an error most of the time. I don't know if I got one from a batch that was all defective or what. But it's not worth the price I paid for it at all. The newer it is, the more problems it has.
Comments (Original): Desde el primer dia con fallos. Ya tuvieron que cambiar una pieza a la semana de tenerlo. Y desde entonces no deja de dar errores. Siempre de agua. Pero todo funciona bien. El unico programa que parece que funciona es el Automatico. El resto siempre dan error la mayoria de las veces. No sé si me ha tocado uno de un lote que esta mal todo o qué. Pero el precio que pagué por él no merece nada la pena. Cuanto más moderno, más problemas.

Sentence (English): It is perfect for our household, as we usually gather the dishes and run it once in the evening.
Comments (English): This is a review of a product I purchased with my own money. I am using it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy a dishwasher sooner. First of all, the cleaning power is excellent. Before using it, I was worried it might not be as clean as hand washing, but after actually using it, dishes and cutlery come out fluffy and clean. Even greasy dishes and pots are cleaned perfectly, significantly reducing the time and effort spent on dishwashing. Delivery arrived the very next day after ordering, and I was very satisfied because the installation technician kept the appointment well and kindly explained the installation and usage methods. The design is also sleek and luxurious, so it doesn't detract from the kitchen atmosphere and actually looks prettier. In particular, it is really comfortable because it is elevated rather than requiring you to squat on the floor or bend over; it puts less strain on your back when loading and unloading dishes. I think it would be great for parents or people with back problems. One aspect I liked more than expected while using it was the noise level. The operation sound is not loud, and you can only hear the gentle trickling of water, so it didn't bother me much even when running it in the evening or at night. It is quiet enough not to interfere at all with watching TV or having a conversation. I am also very satisfied with the automatic door opening feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to allow internal moisture to escape, drying is much more effective. I was surprised that even without the hot air drying function, the dishes dried faster than expected and there were almost no water stains. The sliding rails are also well-made and move smoothly, so dishes move effortlessly without any resistance when loading or unloading. It feels stable even when heavy dishes are placed on it, and the storage space is more generous than expected, allowing you to put in several dishes at once. Since we collect the day's dishes and process them all at once, we save water and time, and I definitely feel like our quality of life has improved. Above all, my mother is the most satisfied. It is a product that satisfies in every aspect, including washing power, convenience, noise, design, the automatic door opening function, and storage convenience. If you are considering buying a dishwasher, I highly recommend this. It really makes you feel like you are freed from the chore of washing dishes!

Sentence (English): It really makes you feel like you are freed from the chore of washing dishes!
Comments (English): This is a review of a product I purchased with my own money. I am using it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy a dishwasher sooner. First of all, the cleaning power is excellent. Before using it, I was worried it might not be as clean as hand washing, but after actually using it, dishes and cutlery come out fluffy and clean. Even greasy dishes and pots are cleaned perfectly, significantly reducing the time and effort spent on dishwashing. Delivery arrived the very next day after ordering, and I was very satisfied because the installation technician kept the appointment well and kindly explained the installation and usage methods. The design is also sleek and luxurious, so it doesn't detract from the kitchen atmosphere and actually looks prettier. In particular, it is really comfortable because it is elevated rather than requiring you to squat on the floor or bend over; it puts less strain on your back when loading and unloading dishes. I think it would be great for parents or people with back problems. One aspect I liked more than expected while using it was the noise level. The operation sound is not loud, and you can only hear the gentle trickling of water, so it didn't bother me much even when running it in the evening or at night. It is quiet enough not to interfere at all with watching TV or having a conversation. I am also very satisfied with the automatic door opening feature. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to allow internal moisture to escape, drying is much more effective. I was surprised that even without the hot air drying function, the dishes dried faster than expected and there were almost no water stains. The sliding rails are also well-made and move smoothly, so dishes move effortlessly without any resistance when loading or unloading. It feels stable even when heavy dishes are placed on it, and the storage space is more generous than expected, allowing you to put in several dishes at once. It is perfect for our household, as we usually gather the dishes and run it once in the evening. Since we collect the day's dishes and process them all at once, we save water and time, and I definitely feel like our quality of life has improved. Above all, my mother is the most satisfied. She says it is so convenient because the burden of doing dishes every day has been reduced. It is an appliance that the whole family is highly satisfied with. Also, since I purchased it during the Samsung cashback event, I was very satisfied with the price. I was able to buy it at a much more reasonable price than at an offline Samsung store or Hi-Mart, and I am even more satisfied because the installation went smoothly. It is a product that satisfies in every aspect, including washing power, convenience, noise, design, the automatic door opening function, and storage convenience. If you are considering buying a dishwasher, I highly recommend this. It really makes you feel like you are freed from the chore of washing dishes!

Sentence (English): After much deliberation to escape the hell of dishwashing, I finally purchased the **Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in 14-Place Dishwasher**!
Comments (English): [ Overwhelming capacity, perfect hot air drying to elevate your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation to escape the hell of dishwashing, I finally purchased the **Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in 14-Place Dishwasher**! To start with the conclusion, my quality of life has skyrocketed to the point where I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. My satisfaction is doubled, especially since I got this great deal thanks to the recent Samsung Appreciation Festival. Here is a summary of the definite advantages I experienced while using it. ### 1. Ample 14-place capacity and smart interior space. While the exterior dimensions are almost identical to the previous 12-place model, the internal storage space has been expanded much more efficiently. Large pots and pans that pile up after just one meal, as well as wide plates, all fit in at once without any stress. Thanks to the 'Max Flex Basket,' the height can be easily adjusted according to the type and size of the dishes, making it incredibly convenient when loading large quantities at once. ### 2. Perfect 'Hot Air Drying' with not a single drop of moisture. The biggest weapon of this product is, as expected, its powerful hot air drying function. Conventional dishwashers left plastic food containers and the backs of cups soaked with water even after washing, causing the hassle of having to wipe them with a paper towel. However, this model automatically opens the door after washing and dries everything thoroughly with hot air, so you can take them out fresh, warm, and dry them right away in the sink cabinet, saving you the trouble of having to do it twice. ### 3. Smart AI Custom Wash and Powerful Cleaning. The 'AI Custom Wash' feature, which automatically detects the level of dirt on dishes and adjusts the wash time and water temperature accordingly, is truly a gem. I put in a greasy grill pan and hardened rice grains without pre-washing, and thanks to the 75-degree high-temperature direct water and three-dimensional water jets, they came out squeaky clean without any slipperiness. If you connect it to the SmartThings app, you receive notifications when a wash is complete, and you can even set the high-temperature sterilization function, giving you peace of mind regarding hygiene. ### 4. Neat BESPOKE Kitchenterior. The design goes without saying. It is a sleek built-in type that fits perfectly along the kitchen sink line, making the kitchen look much more spacious and giving it a luxurious feel. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet; it is so silent that if you run it late at night and go into the bedroom, you won't even know it is running. **Overall Review**. It is the number one contributor to drastically reducing housework time. I am extremely satisfied because I can take a complete rest instead of doing the dishes. If you are looking for a large-capacity dishwasher that dries thoroughly, I would definitely recommend this.

They say dishwashers get cleaner than hand washing. After finishing, I really can feel a squeaky cleanness that I never experienced when washing by hand. It's a whole new world. They said that using standard mode once a day for a month costs about 3,000 to 7,000 won. For those curious about the electricity bill, I have attached a photo, so please take a look. Considering I'm getting a discount of about 100,000 won, I think the price is pretty good. We are a family of three, including our baby. We live in a rented apartment, so I was really worried. It was so exhausting because whenever I started washing dishes, the baby would cling to my legs and cry, preventing me from doing them; I had to split the work into several batches. When the baby was asleep, all I wanted to do was rest, but if I kept putting it off because it was a hassle, it was only a matter of time before the dishes piled up. It was a daily routine of waking up in the morning, hurriedly washing only the baby's dishes, and using them. When I actually received it, I was surprised by how big it was, and the design is so pretty. The buttons are intuitive to use, so you'll understand everything after pressing them just once. They say dishwashers get cleaner than hand washing. After finishing, I really can feel a squeaky cleanness that I never experienced when washing by hand. It's a whole new world. It takes about 1 hour and 35 minutes on standard mode, and there is also a rapid mode. The technician explained that although the product has an energy rating of level 2... They said that if I use rapid or other modes, I should consider it as level 3. I was worried about the electricity bill, so I asked ChatGPT. They said that using standard mode once a day for a month costs about 3,000 to 7,000 won. For those curious about the electricity bill, I have attached a photo, so please take a look. Arranging the dishes is also important when using the dishwasher. Of course, I tried my best to do it well, but there were some parts that weren't cleaned properly because the water streams didn't reach them. I think it would be good to learn this by reviewing how I stacked the dishes while taking them out. It looks like a few trial and error steps will be necessary! Oh, and after paying for the dishwasher, I excitedly went to buy dishwasher detergent, but it was more expensive than I thought. That was something I hadn't anticipated. Sentence (English): Just got this delivered today and Home Depot's delivery team for this delivery was excellent.
Comments (English): [ Quiet but some poor design choices ] || ---------------- || Just got this delivered today and Home Depot's delivery team for this delivery was excellent. The Dishwasher arrived without a scratch and it's running currently. First impression:. Loading: Poor rack space. Any large dishes like Pasta plates simply do not fit without taking up the majority of the rack. It seems that it's designed to handle plates, cutlery, glasses and small bowls but nothing else larger without taking up the majority of the rack. Run: Very quiet. My counter top ice maker came on and it's louder than then dishwasher is. Even the sound of the water draining is louder than the machine running. Hookup: Hoses hooked up no problem. Clean fit, locked in place and sealed with no effort. Power cord: Extremely short power cord (maybe 30 inches long max). Doesn't reach either outlet on the counter top. My sink is in the middle of the counter top and I have 2 power outlets. One between the Sink and the stove and one between the Sink and the Fridge. The closer outlet is on the stove side and the power cord is 15-18 inches too short to reach it with the unit in front of the sink. Pushed the dishwasher over to the maximum reach of the hoses and still cannot reach either outlet. Had to plug it into a power bar on the counter top to be able to run it. Very poor design choice. So unless you have an outlet pretty much right next to your sink which is an electrocution/safety hazard, you'll need to find another solution to power the unit as a power bar is not the best option for this either. May need to change the wire for a longer one which will void it's warranty.

Sentence (English): I used to enjoy doing the dishes, but at some point, I felt like it was too much of a waste of time, so I decided to buy a dishwasher and replaced my entire sink base cabinet.
Comments (English): I used to enjoy doing the dishes, but at some point, I felt like it was too much of a waste of time, so I decided to buy a dishwasher and replaced my entire sink base cabinet. Because of the dishwasher, and since I mainly buy appliances at Hi-Mart, I would log into the app whenever I had a spare moment, waiting for a hot deal to pop up, and I managed to purchase it at a super low price. I purchased it on May 3rd, and the installation is scheduled for June 18th. Thank you for holding the delivery for over a month. The professional installer was so cheerful while working that I really enjoyed watching him install it the whole time. Thank you so much. To get back to the point, this is the appliance I like the most out of all the ones I’ve bought in my life. I put in a pot covered in beef fat from making beef seaweed soup the day before—I just scraped off a few pieces of burnt-on seaweed—and wow... it came out cleaner than usual hand washing. It washes ladles and other greasy plastic dishes so cleanly; doing greasy dishes in this weather would normally require rinsing them multiple times with hot water and sweating profusely just to barely manage it, but this dishwasher finished it in a ridiculously easy way. This is the first time I’ve ever been this excited about an appliance. I find it so convenient that I don't need to use salt or rinse just by adding one all-in-one tablet. It's really the best!

Sentence (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely pick the dishwasher.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely pick the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call a dishwasher an essential appliance. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. I can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue on the dishes. I also barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that users of conventional dishwashers often complain about. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dry cleanly and fluffily, ready for immediate storage. Convenience is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height maximizes space utilization. It is incredibly convenient to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. The noise level was also satisfactory. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look less like a mere appliance and more like an integral part of the kitchen decor. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.
Comments (Original): 주방에서 가장 만족도가 높은 가전제품을 꼽으라면 단연 식기세척기라고 생각합니다. 처음에는 '설거지를 직접 하는 게 더 빠르지 않을까?'라는 생각도 있었지만, 실제로 사용해 보니 왜 많은 사람들이 식기세척기를 필수 가전이라고 말하는지 알게 되었습니다. 특히 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 식기세척기는 디자인, 세척력, 편의성까지 모두 만족스러운 제품이었습니다.가장 먼저 만족스러웠던 부분은 뛰어난 세척력입니다. 평소 국물 요리나 기름진 음식을 자주 먹는 편이라 설거지할 때 기름때 제거가 번거로웠는데, 식기세척기를 사용한 이후로는 그런 걱정이 없어졌습니다. 프라이팬, 냄비, 접시, 수저 등 다양한 식기를 한 번에 넣고 세척할 수 있으며, 식기 표면에 남아 있던 기름기와 음식물 자국도 깨끗하게 제거됩니다. 특히 고온수 세척 기능이 적용되어 손으로 설거지할 때보다 더욱 위생적으로 관리할 수 있다는 점이 큰 장점입니다.건조 성능도 매우 우수합니다. 세척이 끝난 후 문이 자동으로 열리면서 내부의 습기를 배출해 주기 때문에 식기에 물방울이 남는 현상이 적습니다. 기존 식기세척기 사용자들이 자주 이야기하는 물 얼룩이나 건조 부족 문제도 거의 느끼지 못했습니다. 유리컵이나 스테인리스 식기도 깨끗하고 뽀송하게 건조되어 바로 수납할 수 있을 정도입니다.사용 편의성 역시 뛰어납니다. 내부 공간이 넓고 선반 구조가 효율적으로 설계되어 있어 다양한 크기의 식기를 수납하기 쉽습니다. 접시뿐 아니라 냄비, 프라이팬, 반찬통까지 넉넉하게 적재할 수 있으며, 선반 높이 조절 기능 덕분에 공간 활용도가 매우 높습니다. 가족 구성원이 많거나 손님이 방문한 날에도 많은 양의 식기를 한 번에 처리할 수 있어 상당히 편리합니다.소음 부분도 만족스러웠습니다. 식기세척기를 작동하면 시끄러울 것이라고 생각했지만 실제 사용 시에는 매우 조용한 편입니다. 저녁 시간이나 야간에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있으며, 거실과 연결된 주방 구조에서도 생활에 큰 방해가 되지 않았습니다. 덕분에 전기요금이 저렴한 시간대에 예약 기능을 활용해 사용하기에도 좋았습니다.디자인 역시 LG 오브제컬렉션답게 고급스럽습니다. 주방 인테리어와 자연스럽게 어우러지는 색상과 깔끔한 마감 덕분에 빌트인 가전 같은 느낌을 줍니다. 단순히 가전제품이 아니라 주방 인테리어의 일부처럼 보일 정도로 세련된 디자인이 인상적이었습니다.위생적인 측면에서도 매우 만족스럽습니다. 고온 세척과 살균 기능을 통해 젖병, 유리컵, 수저 등을 더욱 깨끗하게 관리할 수 있으며, 손 설거지보다 세균 제거 효과가 뛰어나다는 점에서 안심하고 사용할 수 있습니다. 특히 가족 건강을 중요하게 생각하는 분들에게 추천할 만한 기능입니다.물 사용량 절감 효과도 체감할 수 있었습니다. 손으로 설거지를 할 때는 생각보다 많은 물을 사용하게 되는데 식기세척기는 필요한 양만 효율적으로 사용하기 때문에 물 절약에 도움이 됩니다. 전기 사용량 역시 예상보다 크지 않아 장기간 사용 시 경제성도 충분히 만족스러운 수준입니다.실제로 몇 달 동안 사용해 보니 가장 큰 장점은 시간을 절약할 수 있다는 점이었습니다. 식사 후 설거지에 사용하던 시간을 가족과 함께 보내거나 휴식을 취하는 시간으로 활용할 수 있게 되었습니다. 특히 맞벌이 가정이나 자녀가 있는 가정이라면 체감 만족도가 더욱 높을 것으로 생각됩니다.종합적으로 평가하면 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 식기세척기는 뛰어난 세척력, 우수한 건조 성능, 넓은 수납공간, 저소음 설계, 고급스러운 디자인까지 모두 갖춘 제품입니다. 설거지로 인한 시간과 노동을 크게 줄여주며 위생적인 식기 관리까지 가능해 삶의 질을 높여주는 가전제품이라고 생각합니다. 식기세척기 구매를 고민하고 있는 분들에게 자신 있게 추천할 수 있으며, 사용 후 만족도가 매우 높은 제품입니다. 별점으로 평가한다면 ★★★★★(5점 만점에 5점)을 주고 싶은 제품입니다.

Sentence (English): In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely pick the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call a dishwasher an essential appliance. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. I can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue on the dishes. I also barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that users of conventional dishwashers often complain about. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dry cleanly and fluffily, ready for immediate storage. Convenience is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height maximizes space utilization. It is incredibly convenient to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. The noise level was also satisfactory. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look less like a mere appliance and more like an integral part of the kitchen decor. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely pick the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call a dishwasher an essential appliance. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. I can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue on the dishes. I also barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that users of conventional dishwashers often complain about. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dry cleanly and fluffily, ready for immediate storage. Convenience is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height maximizes space utilization. It is incredibly convenient to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. The noise level was also satisfactory. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look less like a mere appliance and more like an integral part of the kitchen decor. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue on the dishes.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely pick the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call a dishwasher an essential appliance. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. I can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue on the dishes. I also barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that users of conventional dishwashers often complain about. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dry cleanly and fluffily, ready for immediate storage. Convenience is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height maximizes space utilization. It is incredibly convenient to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. The noise level was also satisfactory. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look less like a mere appliance and more like an integral part of the kitchen decor. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dry cleanly and fluffily, ready for immediate storage.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely pick the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call a dishwasher an essential appliance. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. I can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue on the dishes. I also barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that users of conventional dishwashers often complain about. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dry cleanly and fluffily, ready for immediate storage. Convenience is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height maximizes space utilization. It is incredibly convenient to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. The noise level was also satisfactory. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look less like a mere appliance and more like an integral part of the kitchen decor. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.
