Sentence (English): It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use.
Comments (English): If I had to choose the most satisfying kitchen appliance, I would definitely say the dishwasher. At first, I wondered, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I realized why so many people call dishwashers essential appliances. In particular, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher was a product that satisfied me in terms of design, cleaning power, and convenience. The first thing I was satisfied with was its excellent cleaning performance. Since I often eat dishes with broth or greasy food, removing grease stains during dishwashing used to be a hassle, but that worry has disappeared since I started using the dishwasher. You can wash various items such as frying pans, pots, plates, and cutlery all at once, and grease and food stains remaining on the surfaces are cleanly removed. A major advantage is the high-temperature water wash function, which allows for more hygienic maintenance than washing by hand. The drying performance is also excellent. Because the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to expel internal moisture, there is minimal water droplet residue left on the dishes. I barely experienced the issues of water stains or insufficient drying that are frequently mentioned by existing dishwasher users. Even glass cups and stainless steel dishes dried cleanly and fluffily, ready to be stored immediately. Convenience of use is also outstanding. The spacious interior and efficiently designed shelf structure make it easy to store dishes of various sizes. It can accommodate not only plates but also pots, pans, and food containers with ample space, and the adjustable shelf height feature maximizes space utilization. It is quite convenient to be able to handle a large volume of dishes at once, even when there are many family members or guests visiting. I was also satisfied with the noise level. I expected the dishwasher to be noisy when running, but it is actually quite quiet during use. It can be used without concern during the evening or at night, and it did not significantly disrupt daily life, even in a kitchen layout connected to the living room. This made it ideal for using the timer function during off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower. The design is also luxurious, as expected from the LG Objet Collection. Thanks to colors that blend naturally with the kitchen interior and a clean finish, it gives the impression of a built-in appliance. The sophisticated design was impressive, making it look like an integral part of the kitchen decor rather than just a simple appliance. I am also very satisfied with its hygiene aspects. With high-temperature washing and sterilization functions, you can keep baby bottles, glass cups, and cutlery cleaner. You can use it with peace of mind as it is more effective at removing germs than hand washing. This feature is particularly recommended for those who prioritize their family's health. I also experienced firsthand the water savings. Hand washing uses more water than expected, but since the dishwasher uses only the necessary amount efficiently, it helps conserve water. Electricity consumption is also lower than anticipated, making it quite economical for long-term use. After using it for several months, the biggest advantage was saving time. I was able to utilize the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals to spend time with my family or relax. I believe the level of satisfaction would be even higher for dual-income households or families with children. Overall, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that possesses everything: excellent cleaning power, superior drying performance, ample storage space, a low-noise design, and a luxurious aesthetic. I believe it is an appliance that improves the quality of life by significantly reducing the time and labor involved in dishwashing and enabling hygienic dish care. I can confidently recommend this product to anyone considering purchasing a dishwasher, and it offers very high satisfaction after use. If I were to rate it, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars.

Sentence (English): This is an honest review of my experience using the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Built-in Filter Dishwasher (14-place setting).
Comments (English): [ It's pretty and washes dishes well. ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of my experience using the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Built-in Filter Dishwasher (14-place setting). I am sharing the vivid pros and cons with those considering a purchase. To start with the conclusion, it is the ultimate household partner that made me realize firsthand the sayings "the bigger, the better" and the industry adage that "a dishwasher is like a housekeeper." 1. The overwhelming convenience of the 14-place setting capacity. While maintaining the same exterior dimensions (standard width of 60cm) as the existing 12-place model, this product maximizes internal storage space. I unconditionally recommend the 14-place model for households of 3 to 4 people. Simultaneous washing of pots and pans: With the 12-place model, I had to wash large pots or pans separately after putting in a few rice bowls; however, with this product, by modifying the 'foldable dish rack' in the bottom basket, a stockpot, a large wok, or 2 to 3 frying pans fit inside at once. Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. The height adjustment is smooth, allowing even tall-necked cups like wine glasses to be stacked stably without bumping. 2. Built-in Kitchen Fit Design and the Neatness of a Built-in Filter. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. Since it filters out limescale and fine impurities from the water, white limescale stains on dishes are virtually non-existent. 3. Cleaning Power and Hygiene (100% Hot Air Drying). No matter how pretty a dishwasher is, it is useless if it doesn't clean well, but the cleaning power is stronger than expected. 360-degree Jet Shot & Tornado Wash Wings: Because water is sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even greasy grilled pans or hardened rice grains are perfectly cleaned by adding the 'Soak' course. The squeaky-clean finish, without the slipperiness typical of hand washing, is fantastic. High-Temperature Direct Water & Hot Air Drying: It sterilizes harmful bacteria with high-temperature direct water at around 75°C, so you can rest assured even when washing baby dishes or bottles. In particular, the '100° Hot Air Drying' function, which is the core of this product, is the best. After the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly (automatic door opening) and completely evaporates the internal moisture with hot air. The chronic problem of water pooling around the rims of plastic containers, which was a common issue with conventional dishwashers, is significantly reduced, leaving items dry so thoroughly that they can be taken out and organized in the pantry immediately. 4. SmartThings App Integration and Quietness. Smartphone Control: When connected to the Samsung SmartThings app, you receive notifications when a wash cycle is finished, and maintenance is convenient as you can intuitively check the remaining filter life. You can also select the 'Night Quiet Course' via the app when running the machine late at night. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Overall Review and Recommended for: The Samsung Bespoke Built-in 14-Place Dishwasher is "the best investment that transforms time spent on housework into time for complete relaxation."* We strongly recommend it to dual-income couples, families with children where the amount of dishwashing is overwhelming, or those who enjoy cooking but find the cleanup a nightmare. Once you experience the squeaky clean sound of freshly washed dishes and their fluffy dry state, you will never be able to go back to washing dishes by hand.
Comments (Original): [ 예쁘고 설거지도 잘되요 ] || ---------------- || 삼성전자 비스포크 빌트인 필터내장형 식기세척기 14인용을 빌트인으로 설치해서 사용하며 느낀 솔직한 후기입니다. 구매를 고민하시는 분들께 생생한 장단점을 공유해 드립니다.​결론부터 말씀드리면, '가전은 거거익선(클수록 좋다)'이라는 말과 '식기세척기는 이모님이다'라는 가전업계의 격언을 온몸으로 실감하게 해 준 최고의 살림 파트너입니다.​1. 14인용 대용량의 압도적인 편리함​기존 12인용과 외관 크기(가로 60cm 표준 규격)는 동일하면서 내부 적재 공간을 극대화한 제품입니다. 3~4인 가구라면 무조건 14인용을 추천합니다.​냄비와 프라이팬 동시 세척: 12인용을 쓸 때는 밥그릇 몇 개 넣으면 큰 냄비나 프라이팬은 따로 설거지해야 했는데, 이 제품은 하단 바스켓의 '접이식 식기 꽂이'를 변형하면 곰솥이나 대형 웍, 프라이팬 2~3개가 한 번에 들어갑니다.​플렉스 바스켓 layout: 맨 윗단은 수저와 조리도구를 펼쳐놓기 좋고, 중단은 컵과 대접, 하단은 큰 접시와 조리 용기를 넣는 구조입니다. 높낮이 조절이 부드럽게 잘 되어서 와인잔처럼 목이 긴 컵도 부딪힘 없이 안정적으로 적재할 수 있습니다.​2. 빌트인 키친핏 디자인과 필터내장형의 깔끔함​주방 인테리어를 중요하게 생각하신다면 비스포크 빌트인 라인은 후회 없는 선택입니다.​완벽한 키친핏: 가구장과 라인이 딱 맞아떨어져 돌출되는 부분 없이 주방이 정돈되어 보입니다. 비스포크 특유의 세련된 도어 패널 색상을 싱크대 하부장과 맞추거나 포인트를 줄 수 있어 시각적 만족도가 매우 높습니다.​필터내장형 급수 시스템: 싱크대 하부장 안쪽 급수 라인에 필터를 내장하는 방식입니다. 덕분에 조리대 위가 지저분해지지 않고 미관상 완벽하게 깔끔합니다. 물속의 석회질이나 미세 이물질을 걸러주니 식기에 하얀 물때(석회 자국)가 생기는 현상도 거의 없습니다.​3. 세척력과 위생 (100℃ 열풍건조)​아무리 예뻐도 설거지가 안 되면 소용없는데, 세척력은 기대 이상으로 강력합니다.​360도 제트샷 & 토네이도 세척날개: 상·중·하단에서 입체적으로 물을 쏴주기 때문에 기름기가 덕지덕지 묻은 고기 구운 팬이나, 딱딱하게 굳은 밥풀도 '불림' 코스를 추가하면 완벽하게 닦여 나옵니다. 손설거지 특유의 미끈거림 없이 뽀드득한 촉감이 예술입니다.​고온 직수 & 열풍건조: 75℃ 안팎의 고온 직수로 유해 세균을 살균해 주니 아기 식기나 젖병을 돌리기에도 안심이 됩니다. 특히 이 제품의 핵심인 '100℃ 열풍건조' 기능은 최고입니다. 세척이 끝난 후 문이 자동으로 살짝 열리면서(자동 문 열림) 뜨거운 바람으로 내부 습기를 완전히 날려줍니다. 기존 식기세척기들의 고질병이었던 '플라스틱 용기 테두리에 물 고임 현상'이 현저히 줄어들어, 바로 꺼내서 펜트리에 정리할 수 있을 정도로 보송보송하게 마릅니다.​4. SmartThings 앱 연동 및 정숙성​스마트폰 제어: 삼성 SmartThings 앱과 연동해 두면 세척이 끝났을 때 알림이 오고, 현재 필터의 수명이 얼마나 남았는지 직관적으로 확인할 수 있어 유지관리가 편합니다. 밤늦게 돌릴 때는 앱으로 '야간 조용 코스'를 선택할 수도 있습니다.​소음 수준: 거실에서 TV를 보고 있으면 식기세척기가 돌아가고 있는지 잘 느껴지지 않을 정도로 조용합니다. 물이 강하게 벽면에 부딪히는 소리나 모터 작동음이 잘 차단되어 야간 설거지도 부담이 전혀 없습니다.​5.총평 및 추천 대상​삼성 비스포크 빌트인 14인용 식기세척기는 '가사 노동의 시간을 온전한 휴식 시간으로 바꾸어 주는 최고의 투자'*​맞벌이 부부, 아이가 있어 설거지 양이 감당 안 되는 가정, 혹은 주방 요리를 좋아하지만 뒷정리가 끔찍했던 분들에게 강력하게 추천합니다. 깨끗하게 씻겨 나온 그릇들의 뽀드득한 소리와 보송한 건조 상태를 경험하고 나면, 다시는 손설거지 시대로 돌아갈 수 없을 것입니다.

The overwhelming convenience of the 14-place setting capacity. I unconditionally recommend the 14-place model for households of 3 to 4 people. Simultaneous washing of pots and pans: With the 12-place model, I had to wash large pots or pans separately after putting in a few rice bowls; however, with this product, by modifying the 'foldable dish rack' in the bottom basket, a stockpot, a large wok, or 2 to 3 frying pans fit inside at once. Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. The squeaky-clean finish, without the slipperiness typical of hand washing, is fantastic. High-Temperature Direct Water & Hot Air Drying: It sterilizes harmful bacteria with high-temperature direct water at around 75°C, so you can rest assured even when washing baby dishes or bottles. You can also select the 'Night Quiet Course' via the app when running the machine late at night. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Once you experience the squeaky clean sound of freshly washed dishes and their fluffy dry state, you will never be able to go back to washing dishes by hand.

The overwhelming convenience of the 14-place setting capacity. I unconditionally recommend the 14-place model for households of 3 to 4 people. Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Sentence (English): Built-in Kitchen Fit Design and the Neatness of a Built-in Filter.
Comments (English): [ It's pretty and washes dishes well. ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of my experience using the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Built-in Filter Dishwasher (14-place setting). I am sharing the vivid pros and cons with those considering a purchase. To start with the conclusion, it is the ultimate household partner that made me realize firsthand the sayings "the bigger, the better" and the industry adage that "a dishwasher is like a housekeeper." 1. The overwhelming convenience of the 14-place setting capacity. While maintaining the same exterior dimensions (standard width of 60cm) as the existing 12-place model, this product maximizes internal storage space. I unconditionally recommend the 14-place model for households of 3 to 4 people. Simultaneous washing of pots and pans: With the 12-place model, I had to wash large pots or pans separately after putting in a few rice bowls; however, with this product, by modifying the 'foldable dish rack' in the bottom basket, a stockpot, a large wok, or 2 to 3 frying pans fit inside at once. Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. The height adjustment is smooth, allowing even tall-necked cups like wine glasses to be stacked stably without bumping. 2. Built-in Kitchen Fit Design and the Neatness of a Built-in Filter. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. Since it filters out limescale and fine impurities from the water, white limescale stains on dishes are virtually non-existent. 3. Cleaning Power and Hygiene (100% Hot Air Drying). No matter how pretty a dishwasher is, it is useless if it doesn't clean well, but the cleaning power is stronger than expected. 360-degree Jet Shot & Tornado Wash Wings: Because water is sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even greasy grilled pans or hardened rice grains are perfectly cleaned by adding the 'Soak' course. The squeaky-clean finish, without the slipperiness typical of hand washing, is fantastic. High-Temperature Direct Water & Hot Air Drying: It sterilizes harmful bacteria with high-temperature direct water at around 75°C, so you can rest assured even when washing baby dishes or bottles. In particular, the '100° Hot Air Drying' function, which is the core of this product, is the best. After the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly (automatic door opening) and completely evaporates the internal moisture with hot air. The chronic problem of water pooling around the rims of plastic containers, which was a common issue with conventional dishwashers, is significantly reduced, leaving items dry so thoroughly that they can be taken out and organized in the pantry immediately. 4. SmartThings App Integration and Quietness. Smartphone Control: When connected to the Samsung SmartThings app, you receive notifications when a wash cycle is finished, and maintenance is convenient as you can intuitively check the remaining filter life. You can also select the 'Night Quiet Course' via the app when running the machine late at night. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Overall Review and Recommended for: The Samsung Bespoke Built-in 14-Place Dishwasher is "the best investment that transforms time spent on housework into time for complete relaxation."* We strongly recommend it to dual-income couples, families with children where the amount of dishwashing is overwhelming, or those who enjoy cooking but find the cleanup a nightmare. Once you experience the squeaky clean sound of freshly washed dishes and their fluffy dry state, you will never be able to go back to washing dishes by hand.

I am sharing the vivid pros and cons with those considering a purchase. The overwhelming convenience of the 14-place setting capacity. While maintaining the same exterior dimensions (standard width of 60cm) as the existing 12-place model, this product maximizes internal storage space. I unconditionally recommend the 14-place model for households of 3 to 4 people. Simultaneous washing of pots and pans: With the 12-place model, I had to wash large pots or pans separately after putting in a few rice bowls; however, with this product, by modifying the 'foldable dish rack' in the bottom basket, a stockpot, a large wok, or 2 to 3 frying pans fit inside at once. Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. The height adjustment is smooth, allowing even tall-necked cups like wine glasses to be stacked stably without bumping. 2. Built-in Kitchen Fit Design and the Neatness of a Built-in Filter. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. Since it filters out limescale and fine impurities from the water, white limescale stains on dishes are virtually non-existent. 3. Cleaning Power and Hygiene (100% Hot Air Drying). No matter how pretty a dishwasher is, it is useless if it doesn't clean well, but the cleaning power is stronger than expected. 360-degree Jet Shot & Tornado Wash Wings: Because water is sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even greasy grilled pans or hardened rice grains are perfectly cleaned by adding the 'Soak' course. The squeaky-clean finish, without the slipperiness typical of hand washing, is fantastic. High-Temperature Direct Water & Hot Air Drying: It sterilizes harmful bacteria with high-temperature direct water at around 75°C, so you can rest assured even when washing baby dishes or bottles. In particular, the '100° Hot Air Drying' function, which is the core of this product, is the best. After the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly (automatic door opening) and completely evaporates the internal moisture with hot air. The chronic problem of water pooling around the rims of plastic containers, which was a common issue with conventional dishwashers, is significantly reduced, leaving items dry so thoroughly that they can be taken out and organized in the pantry immediately. 4. SmartThings App Integration and Quietness. Smartphone Control: When connected to the Samsung SmartThings app, you receive notifications when a wash cycle is finished, and maintenance is convenient as you can intuitively check the remaining filter life. You can also select the 'Night Quiet Course' via the app when running the machine late at night. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Overall Review and Recommended for: The Samsung Bespoke Built-in 14-Place Dishwasher is "the best investment that transforms time spent on housework into time for complete relaxation."* We strongly recommend it to dual-income couples, families with children where the amount of dishwashing is overwhelming, or those who enjoy cooking but find the cleanup a nightmare. Once you experience the squeaky clean sound of freshly washed dishes and their fluffy dry state, you will never be able to go back to washing dishes by hand.

The overwhelming convenience of the 14-place setting capacity. I unconditionally recommend the 14-place model for households of 3 to 4 people. Simultaneous washing of pots and pans: With the 12-place model, I had to wash large pots or pans separately after putting in a few rice bowls; however, with this product, by modifying the 'foldable dish rack' in the bottom basket, a stockpot, a large wok, or 2 to 3 frying pans fit inside at once. Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. No matter how pretty a dishwasher is, it is useless if it doesn't clean well, but the cleaning power is stronger than expected. 360-degree Jet Shot & Tornado Wash Wings: Because water is sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even greasy grilled pans or hardened rice grains are perfectly cleaned by adding the 'Soak' course. The squeaky-clean finish, without the slipperiness typical of hand washing, is fantastic. After the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly (automatic door opening) and completely evaporates the internal moisture with hot air. You can also select the 'Night Quiet Course' via the app when running the machine late at night. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Once you experience the squeaky clean sound of freshly washed dishes and their fluffy dry state, you will never be able to go back to washing dishes by hand.

Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. Since it filters out limescale and fine impurities from the water, white limescale stains on dishes are virtually non-existent. 3. Cleaning Power and Hygiene (100% Hot Air Drying). No matter how pretty a dishwasher is, it is useless if it doesn't clean well, but the cleaning power is stronger than expected. 360-degree Jet Shot & Tornado Wash Wings: Because water is sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even greasy grilled pans or hardened rice grains are perfectly cleaned by adding the 'Soak' course. The squeaky-clean finish, without the slipperiness typical of hand washing, is fantastic. High-Temperature Direct Water & Hot Air Drying: It sterilizes harmful bacteria with high-temperature direct water at around 75°C, so you can rest assured even when washing baby dishes or bottles. In particular, the '100° Hot Air Drying' function, which is the core of this product, is the best. After the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly (automatic door opening) and completely evaporates the internal moisture with hot air. You can also select the 'Night Quiet Course' via the app when running the machine late at night. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Once you experience the squeaky clean sound of freshly washed dishes and their fluffy dry state, you will never be able to go back to washing dishes by hand.

Comments (English): [ It's pretty and washes dishes well. ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of my experience using the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Built-in Filter Dishwasher (14-place setting). I am sharing the vivid pros and cons with those considering a purchase. To start with the conclusion, it is the ultimate household partner that made me realize firsthand the sayings "the bigger, the better" and the industry adage that "a dishwasher is like a housekeeper." 1. The overwhelming convenience of the 14-place setting capacity. While maintaining the same exterior dimensions (standard width of 60cm) as the existing 12-place model, this product maximizes internal storage space. I unconditionally recommend the 14-place model for households of 3 to 4 people. Simultaneous washing of pots and pans: With the 12-place model, I had to wash large pots or pans separately after putting in a few rice bowls; however, with this product, by modifying the 'foldable dish rack' in the bottom basket, a stockpot, a large wok, or 2 to 3 frying pans fit inside at once. Flex Basket Layout: The top shelf is ideal for spreading out cutlery and cooking utensils, the middle section for cups and bowls, and the bottom section for large plates and cooking containers. The height adjustment is smooth, allowing even tall-necked cups like wine glasses to be stacked stably without bumping. 2. Built-in Kitchen Fit Design and the Neatness of a Built-in Filter. If you prioritize kitchen interior design, the Bespoke Built-in line is a choice you won't regret. Perfect Kitchen Fit: The lines align perfectly with the cabinets, ensuring a neat and organized kitchen appearance without any protruding parts. Visual satisfaction is very high as you can match Bespoke's signature sophisticated door panel colors to the sink base cabinets or use them as accents. Built-in Filter Water Supply System: This system integrates a filter into the water supply line inside the sink base cabinet. Thanks to this, the countertop remains clean and aesthetically pleasing. Since it filters out limescale and fine impurities from the water, white limescale stains on dishes are virtually non-existent. 3. Cleaning Power and Hygiene (100% Hot Air Drying). No matter how pretty a dishwasher is, it is useless if it doesn't clean well, but the cleaning power is stronger than expected. 360-degree Jet Shot & Tornado Wash Wings: Because water is sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even greasy grilled pans or hardened rice grains are perfectly cleaned by adding the 'Soak' course. The squeaky-clean finish, without the slipperiness typical of hand washing, is fantastic. High-Temperature Direct Water & Hot Air Drying: It sterilizes harmful bacteria with high-temperature direct water at around 75°C, so you can rest assured even when washing baby dishes or bottles. In particular, the '100° Hot Air Drying' function, which is the core of this product, is the best. After the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly (automatic door opening) and completely evaporates the internal moisture with hot air. The chronic problem of water pooling around the rims of plastic containers, which was a common issue with conventional dishwashers, is significantly reduced, leaving items dry so thoroughly that they can be taken out and organized in the pantry immediately. 4. SmartThings App Integration and Quietness. Smartphone Control: When connected to the Samsung SmartThings app, you receive notifications when a wash cycle is finished, and maintenance is convenient as you can intuitively check the remaining filter life. You can also select the 'Night Quiet Course' via the app when running the machine late at night. Noise Level: It is so quiet that you can barely tell the dishwasher is running while watching TV in the living room. Sounds of water hitting the walls and motor noise are effectively blocked, making nighttime dishwashing a complete hassle. 5. Overall Review and Recommended for: The Samsung Bespoke Built-in 14-Place Dishwasher is "the best investment that transforms time spent on housework into time for complete relaxation."* We strongly recommend it to dual-income couples, families with children where the amount of dishwashing is overwhelming, or those who enjoy cooking but find the cleanup a nightmare. Once you experience the squeaky clean sound of freshly washed dishes and their fluffy dry state, you will never be able to go back to washing dishes by hand.

Sentence (English): This is a review after using the Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher DW80F73Y1UEW for about a month since installation.
Comments (English): [ Our first dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is a review after using the Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher DW80F73Y1UEW for about a month since installation. I used to mainly wash dishes by hand, but my lifestyle has changed significantly since using the dishwasher. Its large capacity of 14 place settings makes it very convenient to load all the dishes from a family meal at once. In particular, it accommodates frying pans, pots, and soup bowls with ample space. The structure of the upper and middle shelves is efficient, offering excellent space utilization. The AI Custom Wash function automatically detects the level of soiling and selects the appropriate course. It is convenient because the user does not need to worry about it separately. The cleaning power is more satisfying than expected. Even greasy dishes are cleaned thoroughly. Coffee stains remaining on cups were also removed cleanly. Thanks to the high-temperature washing function, it feels hygienic. I feel more at ease when washing children's dishes or tumblers. The operating noise is quite quiet. It is not bothersome even when using it in the evening. There is no major inconvenience even in a layout where the kitchen and living room are connected. The automatic door opening drying function is also very satisfactory. The door opens automatically after the wash is complete, improving drying performance. Of plastic containers Water condensation has also been significantly reduced. As it is a Grade 1 energy efficiency product, the burden of electricity usage is low. It also seems to be more water-efficient than hand washing. The SmartThings integration feature is also useful. You can check the washing status even when you are away. It is convenient to receive notifications on your smartphone when the wash is complete. The white color design is clean and luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior. The sense of unity is excellent after built-in installation. The time spent washing dishes after meals has been greatly reduced. Comments (English): [ OK dishwasher--Rust spots on tub after three washes. ] || ---------------- || I have just installed this dishwasher (purchased the dishwasher just a couple of weeks ago) and used it three times, and there are rust spots --like a field of rust spots--on the bottom of the tub near the door. My prior very old dishwasher did not have rust spots, ever! Home Depot can't do anything as it's been more than 48 hours since delivery, and I've been on with 4 successive people at Samsung. I call home depot, and then they tell me to call Samsung to set up a 'service appointment' for them to inspect the dishwasher. I insisted that they call Samsung, since that's what their (home depot) email says they will do. They called Samsung and after a lengthy wait, I started over with a new department at Samsung, and provide all information to two different people in sequence, Now they are requiring a technician come and view the damage/issue. Total amount of time on phone is nearly 1.5 hours. I spoke with 3 people at home depot, 6 people at samsung, and spent a bit of research online to figure out what to do. and now waiting for a local service center to contact me to come look at the rust spots that are quite evidently there.

Sentence (English): I'm never the person to write reviews.
Comments (English): I'm never the person to write reviews. Around seven years ago, I was fooled into thinking I was buying quality appliances because they had a warranty campaign offering ten years on motor and compressors. My wife and I bought a matching kitchen set: fridge, stove, dishwasher, and microwave. All told, over $4000 of absolute problems. Every appliance has been repaired either by a professional or by myself. The dishwasher itself has been repaired at least five times, mostly due to a poor design on the door switch. Recently, it started making a horrifying whining noise. I did about 30 seconds of research, and LG has a known problem with the pump seal failing and letting water run into the motor, destroying the bearings. I called LG and got the famous runaround, saying that I needed to go to an authorized service company. I called the service company, and it was going to be over $300 before I even started a repair. I removed the pump myself. I have 100% clear, plain-as-day evidence with photos and have still gotten the runaround. Long story short: LG will not stand behind their products. They will make you jump through hoops designed to make repairs so expensive you have no alternative but to replace the appliance. This used to be a good company, but they are not the same LG! Buyer beware!

Sentence (English): As our family grew, the amount of dishes to wash each day increased significantly.
Comments (English): As our family grew, the amount of dishes to wash each day increased significantly. In the past, hand washing was sufficient, but after the family expanded, a single meal would leave a huge pile of dishes, cups, and cutlery, making the time spent washing dishes feel burdensome. After much consideration, I decided to purchase the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Hot Air Dryer Dishwasher (14-place setting). After using it for a few weeks, I am generally very satisfied with the product. Its biggest advantage is, of course, the ample storage capacity. Perhaps because it is a 14-place setting model, I can fit dishes, pots, and pans from a meal all in one go, so there is almost no need to run it in separate batches. It was especially convenient on weekends when the whole family gathers for a meal; even though the amount of dishes increases significantly, there is still plenty of room for storage. The cleaning performance is also satisfactory. Even greasy plates and dishes with liquid stains were cleaned thoroughly, and I felt that the dishes were being kept more hygienic than when washing by hand. The hot air drying function was also more satisfying than expected; it dried well, leaving minimal water stains, and allowed for immediate storage, which was very convenient. I was also impressed by the AI features that adjust the washing process according to usage patterns. It is intuitive and easy to operate, so even first-time users could adapt easily. True to BESPOKE's reputation, the design is clean and luxurious, blending well with my kitchen interior. However, it isn't without its drawbacks. The initial cost of remodeling the sink and the price of the product might feel a bit burdensome. Also, using the dishwasher efficiently requires a knack for arranging dishes in the proper places, and I experienced some trial and error at first as I wasn't used to it. Nevertheless, considering the time and effort I used to spend on washing dishes, I believe it is a sufficiently satisfying investment. In particular, for households like mine where the number of family members has increased and the amount of dishwashing has grown, this product can definitely improve the quality of life. I sigh less often looking at piles of dishes after meals, and I now spend more time with my family. Overall, I am satisfied with the cleaning power, drying performance, capacity, and design, so I think it is a dishwasher worth recommending.

Comments (English): As our family grew, the amount of dishes to wash each day increased significantly. In the past, hand washing was sufficient, but after the family expanded, a single meal would leave a huge pile of dishes, cups, and cutlery, making the time spent washing dishes feel burdensome. After much consideration, I decided to purchase the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Hot Air Dryer Dishwasher (14-place setting). After using it for a few weeks, I am generally very satisfied with the product. Its biggest advantage is, of course, the ample storage capacity. Perhaps because it is a 14-place setting model, I can fit dishes, pots, and pans from a meal all in one go, so there is almost no need to run it in separate batches. It was especially convenient on weekends when the whole family gathers for a meal; even though the amount of dishes increases significantly, there is still plenty of room for storage. The cleaning performance is also satisfactory. Even greasy plates and dishes with liquid stains were cleaned thoroughly, and I felt that the dishes were being kept more hygienic than when washing by hand. The hot air drying function was also more satisfying than expected; it dried well, leaving minimal water stains, and allowed for immediate storage, which was very convenient. I was also impressed by the AI features that adjust the washing process according to usage patterns. It is intuitive and easy to operate, so even first-time users could adapt easily. True to BESPOKE's reputation, the design is clean and luxurious, blending well with my kitchen interior. However, it isn't without its drawbacks. The initial cost of remodeling the sink and the price of the product might feel a bit burdensome. Also, using the dishwasher efficiently requires a knack for arranging dishes in the proper places, and I experienced some trial and error at first as I wasn't used to it. Nevertheless, considering the time and effort I used to spend on washing dishes, I believe it is a sufficiently satisfying investment. In particular, for households like mine where the number of family members has increased and the amount of dishwashing has grown, this product can definitely improve the quality of life. I sigh less often looking at piles of dishes after meals, and I now spend more time with my family. Overall, I am satisfied with the cleaning power, drying performance, capacity, and design, so I think it is a dishwasher worth recommending.
